usageNotes: Poll this endpoint after any async PVE operation returns a UPID to determine whether the task is still running or has completed. The caller must hold Resource.Audit on the remote; the remote PVE node must be reachable from PDM at call time. Set wait=true to block until the task finishes instead of polling in a loop, but note that long-running tasks (migrations, backups) may cause the request to time out.

examples.summary: Check status of a VM migration task on the pve-prod remote

tips: exitstatus is only present in the response when status='stopped'; check for its presence before reading it.
exitstatus='OK' indicates success; any other value (e.g. 'ERROR: ...') indicates failure.
Use wait=true for short-lived tasks (snapshot, config change) to avoid a polling round-trip; avoid it for migrations or backups where the PDM request may time out.
The UPID minimum length of 42 chars includes the node name and timestamps — pass it verbatim from the originating operation response.
